verdict.rationale: Vercel access tokens are explicitly documented as scope-limited by construction, with three defined scoping levels (account/team/project) so a token can be constrained to only the resources an agent needs, and this scoping is the documented mechanism used to grant agents access via CLI/API/MCP. Combined with the MCP server's OAuth-gated, per-client-approved access model, this concretely delivers least-privilege credential issuance for agents. Missing for 10: no independent/hands-on verification of enforcement (e.g., a third-party test confirming a project-scoped token actually fails against other resources) and no finer-grained per-tool/action scopes beyond the three tiers.
